title: Physarum configuration
description: Every key is required. A candidate may change any value inside these bounds. Values outside the bounds fail the candidate.

palette.description: Named colour ramp used by the renderer.

gamma.description: Display gamma. Values below 1 brighten the trail.

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio. Evaluation pins this to 1.

sensorAngle.description: Angular offset of the left and right sensors, in degrees.

decay.description: Trail fade alpha per step, 0 keeps the trail, 255 clears it.

spawnRadius.description: Half-size of the square spawn box at the centre, in trail pixels.

scale.description: Trail resolution as a fraction of the viewport.

gain.description: Trail value that maps to full brightness.

speed.description: Simulation steps per rendered frame during live playback.

seed.description: Random seed. 0 is a valid seed.
